commit_message: Resolve ADR0127 sprite assets during scene conversion
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Continues ADR0127 first-release completion on the existing Draft PR. Resolves Sprite Atlas regions by stable SpriteId during atomic scene conversion, shares decoded source textures with the existing rendering texture path, retains per-entity immutable SpriteRef bindings for animation, and exposes Project2dSettings as the runtime sorting/render policy resource. No GPU handles or UVs are persisted.
